title: Eccentric gym + easy spin
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: light eccentric circuit only. Box step-downs 2x8/leg 4s lowering; single-leg decline squat 2x8/leg; Copenhagen plank 3x30s/side; single-leg calf raise 3x15. Then 30min easy spin.
GYM: this IS the gym session, kept light on purpose.
FUEL: protein within an hour.
STOP RULE: stop the step-downs at any lateral knee pain, not soreness. No extra sets, Saturday's descents are this week's eccentric load.
WHY: keeps the eccentric habit without pre-fatiguing the quads the day before the mountain long run.
